english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for feeling or showing surprise.
This is the all-purpose choice for saying someone is amazed or greatly surprised.
This is the all-purpose choice for being surprised or taken aback without necessarily implying extreme distress.
This is the all-purpose choice for saying that someone is astonished or surprised.

examples.english: I’m really surprised that you finished the report so quickly.
examples.traditional: 我真係驚訝你咁快就做完份報告。
